notes.title: Radventure is Relaunching on Kickstarter and You’re Invited!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey Radventurers![/b] Buckle up: Radventure, the comedy RPG where the narrator definitely has it out for you, is hitting [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] and [b]relaunching on Kickstarter[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s Radventure?[/b] It’s a hilarious, story-driven RPG crafted by real-life sketch and improv comedians. Expect chaos, fourth-wall-smashing antics, and laugh-out-loud moments. If you vibe with The Stanley Parable, Undertale, or Monkey Island, this is your jam. Play as Ryle, a half-elf rogue, on a quest to... well, let’s just say it involves a graveyard and some creative revenge. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Try the Demo![/b] Dive into our free demo on Steam. Explore the first area, battle with our active-turn-based combat, and tell the narrator they’re doing a terrible job. Wishlist us while you’re at it: Radventure on Steam! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Kickstarter Relaunch![/b] We’ve revamped our campaign with better rewards, a shiny new trailer, and even bigger laughs. Help us bring Radventure to life by joining the journey: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/923076222/radventure-the-rise-of-ryle "]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/923076222/radventure-the-rise-of-ryle [/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Why Now?[/b] We’ve listened to feedback, polished the demo, and are ready to make this comedy RPG epic. Steam Next Fest is the perfect time to jump in, try the demo, and back our Kickstarter to support hand-crafted art and a stellar voice cast. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for joining the chaos. [/p][p][/p][p]-The Radventure Team-[/p]

notes.title: Radventure Demo Launched!
notes.notes:
Wow!  It's been quite the journey just getting here, but the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3318680/Radventure_Demo/]Radventure Demo has officially launched[/url]!  If you haven't already, head on over and download it for FREE!  It's a fun little playthrough of the first full area of the Radventure game, and it holds more than a few secrets and interactions... CAN YOU FIND THEM ALL?!

Now that our little slice of insanity has been released into the wild, keep an eye out for our upcoming Kickstarter campaign.

The purpose of this campaign will be to hire additional artists to help with asset creation and speed up the production process overall.

If that sounds interesting to you, feel free to [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/923076222/radventure-an-interactive-comedy]stop by the landing page[/url] and give us a follow so you can be notified when the campaign goes live.

Ultimately though, we really just want to thank anyone who gives our silly little demo a download, play... or really just even looks in our direction.  You guys rock.

-Jeff
